chunks: And in the narration of Sulaymān ibn Dāwūd al-Minqarī, from Fuḍayl ibn ʿIyāḍ, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.

At the end of a hadith, he says therein: "It was only called the Greater Pilgrimage because it was the year in which the Muslims and the polytheists performed Hajj, and the polytheists did not perform Hajj after that year."

key_terms.الْمُسْلِمُونَ: the Muslims who performed hajj that year
key_terms.الْمُشْرِكُونَ: the polytheists who were still present in that year's hajj
key_terms.بَعْدَ: indicating what occurred after that year
key_terms.سَنَةَ: a particular year being referred to

ai.seo_question: Why was it called al-Hajj al-Akbar in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith explains why that pilgrimage was called al-Hajj al-Akbar. It identifies it as the year in which both Muslims and polytheists were present for hajj, after which the polytheists no longer performed hajj.
